item.description: In this episode, we sit down with Vanessa Tompkins, wife and caregiver to Mike, who has been battling Stage IV metastasized ocular melanoma. Over the past five years, Vanessa has supported Mike through weekly immunotherapy, four major surgeries—including the removal of his left eye, liver surgery, triple hernia repair, and open-heart surgery—and countless challenges along the way.
